answer:
Part A:
We solve the system of congruences:
$x \equiv 4 \pmod{16}$
$x \equiv 2 \pmod{7}$
$x \equiv 9 \pmod{11}$

From $x \equiv 4 \pmod{16}$, we can write $x = 16k + 4$.
Substituting into the second congruence:
$16k + 4 \equiv 2 \pmod{7} \implies 2k \equiv -2 \equiv 5 \pmod{7} \implies k \equiv 6 \pmod{7}$.
Thus, $x = 16(7m + 6) + 4 = 112m + 100$.

Substituting into the third congruence:
$112m + 100 \equiv 9 \pmod{11} \implies 2m + 1 \equiv 9 \pmod{11} \implies 2m \equiv 8 \pmod{11} \implies m \equiv 4 \pmod{11}$.
Thus, the smallest positive integer is $x = 112(4) + 100 = 548$.

Part B:
Income = $81,900.
- First bracket (up to $12,500 at 8%): $12,500 \times 0.08 = \$1,000$
- Second bracket ($12,500 to $52,000 at 20%): $(\$52,000 - \$12,500) \times 0.20 = \$39,500 \times 0.20 = \$7,900$
- Third bracket (above $52,000 at 30%): $(\$81,900 - \$52,000) \times 0.30 = \$29,900 \times 0.30 = \$8,970$
Total tax before credit = $\$1,000 + \$7,900 + \$8,970 = \$17,870$.

Credit calculation:
Income above $\$60,000$ = $\$81,900 - \$60,000 = \$21,900$.
Credit reduction = $5\% \times \$21,900 = \$1,095$.
Allowable credit = $\$1,200 - \$1,095 = \$105$.

Final tax owed = $\$17,870 - \$105 = \$17,765.00$.

Part C:
Let $N = 12000$. By the Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion, the number of integers divisible by at least one of 5, 7, 11 is:
$|S| = \lfloor N/5 \rfloor + \lfloor N/7 \rfloor + \lfloor N/11 \rfloor - \lfloor N/35 \rfloor - \lfloor N/55 \rfloor - \lfloor N/77 \rfloor + \lfloor N/385 \rfloor$
$|S| = 2400 + 1714 + 1090 - 342 - 218 - 155 + 31 = 4520$.

The number of these also divisible by 17 is:
$|S \cap M_{17}| = \lfloor N/85 \rfloor + \lfloor N/119 \rfloor + \lfloor N/187 \rfloor - \lfloor N/595 \rfloor - \lfloor N/935 \rfloor - \lfloor N/1309 \rfloor + \lfloor N/6545 \rfloor$
$|S \cap M_{17}| = 141 + 100 + 64 - 20 - 12 - 9 + 1 = 265$.

The total count is:
$4520 - 265 = 4255$.

FINAL: 548; 17765; 4255
